name: L2 · 你们想吃什么就点什么
titleCn: 你们想吃什么就点什么
titleEn: You can order whatever you feel like

intro.cn: 在饭馆，王一雪、刘明、白家月和李文在点菜。
intro.en: At the restaurant, Wang Yixue, Liu Ming, Bai Jiayue, and Li Wen were deciding what to order.

questions.q: 白家月想吃什么中国菜？

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 家月、李文，你们看看菜单，想吃点儿什么？
lines.en: Jiayue, Li Wen, take a look at the menu. What do you feel like eating?

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 谢谢一雪姐，我都可以，你们点吧。
lines.en: Thank you, Yixue. I'm good with anything—why don't you go ahead and order?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 飞了这么远，现在还真是又饿又渴。
lines.en: After such a long flight, I'm really hungry and thirsty.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 那多点点儿，别客气。你们喝什么饮料？
lines.en: Then let's order plenty—don't be shy. What would you like to drink?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 好久没喝中国茶，也好久没吃饺子了。我想喝绿茶、吃饺子，可以吗？
lines.en: It's been ages since I've had Chinese tea or jiaozi. I'd like some green tea and jiaozi, if that's okay.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 没问题。你们看看还想吃什么。
lines.en: No problem. Have another look and see if there's anything else you'd like.

postQuestions.q: 白家月现在觉得怎么样？

intro.cn: 在饭馆，王一雪、刘明、白家月和李文一起吃饭。
intro.en: At the restaurant, Wang Yixue, Liu Ming, Bai Jiayue, and Li Wen were having a meal together.

questions.q: 王一雪让服务员拿什么？
这家饭馆的服务怎么样？

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 服务员，再给我们拿一双筷子、一个勺子和一个碗。
lines.en: Waitress, could you please bring another pair of chopsticks, a spoon, and a bowl?

lines.speaker: 服务员
lines.cn: 好的，请等一下，我马上就去拿。
lines.en: Certainly. Please wait a moment—I'll bring them right away.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 这家饭馆的服务很热情，菜也都做得很好吃。你们尝尝，看喜不喜欢这些菜。
lines.en: The service here is always warm and welcoming, and all the dishes are delicious. Give it a try and let me know what you think!

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 哪个菜都好吃。您点的这些菜真不错。
lines.en: Every dish is delicious. The dishes you ordered are really great.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 这里的饭菜又便宜又好吃，我们经常来，服务员都记住我们爱吃的菜了。
lines.en: The food here is both affordable and tasty. We come here so often that the staff already know our favorite dishes.

lines.speaker: 服务员
lines.cn: 王姐，您经常来吃饭，今天送您一些水果，请慢用。
lines.en: Ms. Wang, since you're such a regular customer, we'd like to offer you some complimentary fruit today. Please enjoy!

postQuestions.q: 王一雪觉得这家饭馆怎么样？
白家月觉得这家饭馆的菜怎么样？
服务员为什么送了一些水果？

words.en: added after a noun or verb to indicate a person

intro.cn: 在饭馆，王一雪、刘明、白家月和李文继续边吃边聊。
intro.en: At the restaurant, Wang Yixue, Liu Ming, Bai Jiayue, and Li Wen carried on chatting over their meal.

questions.q: 在这家饭馆，白家月喜欢吃什么？
王一雪为什么说“不用拿菜单”？

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 这个鸡肉饭太好吃了，我要再来吃一次。
lines.en: This chicken rice is so delicious! I'll definitely come back for it again.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 你可以拿走这张菜单，看看下次还吃点儿什么。
lines.en: You can take this menu with you and check what else you might want to order next time.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 不用拿菜单，在手机上就能看到，也可以选好了让他们给你送。
lines.en: No need to take the menu. You can check it on your phone and even place an order for delivery.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 他们家还能送外卖？
lines.en: They do delivery here?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 对，现在很多饭馆都能送外卖，想吃什么就点什么。
lines.en: Yes! Many restaurants offer delivery these days. You can order whatever you feel like.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 那真是太方便了！
lines.en: That's really convenient!

postQuestions.q: 白家月为什么还要再来吃一次？
这家饭馆可以怎么点菜？
听说很多饭馆都能送外卖，白家月觉得怎么样？

intro.cn: 在李文家，李文在写日记。
intro.en: At home, Li Wen was writing in his diary.

questions.q: 快要考试的时候，李文怎么吃饭？
回到中国了，李文为什么很高兴？
options: 每天能吃到妈妈做的饭

lines.cn: 这些年在国外，我很少自己做饭。
lines.en: Over the years I spent abroad, I rarely cooked for myself.

lines.cn: 早饭我吃一个面包，有时候吃一块蛋糕，再喝一杯咖啡。
lines.en: For breakfast, I would usually have a piece of bread, sometimes a slice of cake, and a cup of coffee.

lines.cn: 午饭和晚饭也都在外面吃。
lines.en: I ate both lunch and dinner out.

lines.cn: 快要考试的时候又忙又累，没时间出去吃饭，家里又什么吃的都没有，我可能好几天只吃方便面。
lines.en: During exam periods, when I was busy and exhausted, with no time to eat out and nothing at home, I could go for days surviving only on instant noodles.

lines.cn: 现在回到中国了，每天能吃到妈妈做的饭，我真是太高兴了！
lines.en: Now that I'm back in China, being able to enjoy my mom's cooking every day makes me incredibly happy!

lines.cn: 有时候妈妈只做几个简单的菜，我也非常爱吃，因为什么都没有妈妈做的饭好吃。
lines.en: Even when she prepares just a few simple dishes, I love them all the same, because nothing in the world tastes better than a meal made by Mom.

postQuestions.q: 李文在国外经常做饭吗？
李文为什么好几天只吃方便面？
回到中国后什么事让他非常高兴？

grammar.note: 并列复句“又……又……”与形容词搭配使用，表示人或者事物同时具有两个特点。基本结构：又+形容词1+又+形容词2。
grammar.noteEn: The coordinate complex sentence “又……又……” is used before adjectives to indicate that a person or thing possesses two characteristics at the same time. Basic structure: 又+Adjective1+又+Adjective2.

items.c: 我现在还真是又饿又渴。
items.en: I'm really hungry and thirsty right now.

items.c: 那个女孩儿又高又漂亮。
items.en: That girl is tall and pretty.

items.c: 这个饭馆的菜又便宜又好吃。
items.en: The food at this restaurant is both cheap and tasty.

practice.cn: 他的新家很大，也很干净。→ ______
他写汉字写得很快，也很漂亮。→ ______
这个超市里的东西很多，也很便宜。→ ______

grammar.cn: 疑问代词的非疑问用法（2）
grammar.note: 疑问代词“哪、哪儿、什么、谁、怎么”等还可以用来表示任指，比如“谁”指任何一个人，“什么”指任何一件东西，句中常用副词“都”与之呼应。
grammar.noteEn: Interrogative pronouns such as “哪”, “哪儿”, “什么”, “谁”, and “怎么” can also be used to express general reference. For example, “谁” refers to any person, while “什么” refers to any thing. The adverb “都” is often used in these sentences in combination with them.

items.c: 这次旅游，我去哪儿都可以。
items.en: For this trip, I can go anywhere.

items.c: 我下午有时间，你想什么时候来都没问题。
items.en: I'm free this afternoon, so you can come whenever you like.

practice.cn: 我喜欢吃中国菜，也喜欢吃外国菜。（什么）→ ______
小李很会做饭，大家都喜欢吃他做的饭。（谁）→ ______
饭馆不太远，我们打车、坐公交车、走路去都可以。（怎么）→ ______

grammar.cn: 疑问代词的非疑问用法（3）
grammar.note: 两个相同的疑问代词可以表示任指，前后呼应，指同一个人、同一件事、同一种方式、同一个时间、同一个地点等。当前后两个分句的主语相同时，后一分句的主语可以省略。当前后两个分句的主语不同时，第二个主语要放在“就”的前面。
grammar.noteEn: Two identical interrogative pronouns can be used for general reference. They echo each other and refer to the same person, thing, manner, time, or place. When the subjects of the two clauses are the same, the subject of the second clause may be omitted. When the subjects are different, the second subject should be placed before “就”.

items.c: 你们想吃什么就点什么。
items.en: Order whatever you feel like eating.

items.c: 你觉得哪个好看就买哪个。
items.en: Buy whichever one you think looks nice.

items.c: 你想去哪儿，我们就去哪儿。
items.en: Wherever you want to go, we'll go there.

tips.note: “上/下+量词”主要用来表示时间顺序，“上”表示过去，“下”表示将来。例如：上次/下次、上周/下周、上个月/下个月。
tips.noteEn: The structure “上/下+measure word” is mainly used to indicate time sequence, with “上” referring to past periods and “下” referring to future periods. For example: 上次 (last time) / 下次 (next time), 上个星期 (last week) / 下个星期 (next week), 上个月 (last month) / 下个月 (next month).

items.c: 上次、下次、上周、下周、上个月、下个月
items.en: last time, next time, last week, next week, last month, next month

classroomActivity.description: 3~4人一组，讨论在饭馆吃饭、点外卖和自己做饭这几种方式中，你们更喜欢哪一种？为什么？回答时，使用本课所学的词语和语言点。讨论过程中边听边做记录，讨论结束后向全班同学汇报本小组的情况。
classroomActivity.descriptionEn: Work in groups of 3-4. Discuss which you prefer: dining at a restaurant, ordering takeout, or cooking at home, and explain why. When responding, use the words and language points covered in this lesson. Take notes while listening during the discussion. After the discussion, report your group's findings to the class.
